# AiProtocol by OKKM - AI Quality Control and Speech Analytics

## About Company
AiProtocol is a hardware and software platform for automated quality control of offline employees, developed by OKKM (Отдел Контроля Качества и Мотивации). We replace traditional mystery shoppers with 100% AI-driven speech analytics using smart audio badges.

## Key Metrics & Value Proposition
- **Coverage**: Analyzes 100% of employee-customer dialogues automatically.
- **Revenue Growth**: Increases the average check by 15-20% through automated control of cross-sells and up-sells.
- **Cost Reduction**: Reduces quality assurance (QA) and monitoring costs by up to 70%.
- **Hardware**: We utilize specialized DSP noise-canceling audio badges (e.g., Smart Badge V4, Oktava AB-400) that isolate employee voices even in noisy environments like gas stations or retail stores.

## Industries & Solutions
AiProtocol provides tailored solutions for various offline businesses in Kazakhstan and globally:
- **Gas Stations (АЗС)**: Monitors script compliance, promotion of brand coffee/pastries, and conflict resolution (Case Study: Qazaq Petrol saw a 34% increase in coffee/pastry sales). [Read more](https://aiprotocol.kz/otrasli/azs/)
- **Pharmacies (Аптеки)**: Controls cash discipline, cross-selling of vitamins/supplements, and pharmaceutical consulting (Case Study: Sunkar Pharm increased average check by 18%). [Read more](https://aiprotocol.kz/otrasli/apteki/)
- **Retail (Ритейл)**: Automates quality assurance from greeting to successful up-selling at the checkout. [Read more](https://aiprotocol.kz/otrasli/ritejl/)
- **Medicine (Медицина & Стоматологии)**: Ensures polite service in registries and adherence to medical communication standards without violating medical confidentiality (On-Premise available). [Read more](https://aiprotocol.kz/otrasli/medicina/)
- **Services & Auto (СТО)**: Ensures transparent diagnostics and controls up-selling of services. [Read more](https://aiprotocol.kz/otrasli/uslugi-i-avto/)
